QuestInfo.name: The Turtles' Goodwill
QuestInfo.0: You gathered the #bWater Drop Flowers#k as requested by Eto. However, it seems Eto has more to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Eto, embarrassed, asks you to deliver the herbs to the Snake Anima. Deliver the herbs to Rami and resolve the misunderstanding.\r\n#r(*If you lose the herb sack, you'll need to forfeit the quest and start over, or talk to Eto.)
QuestInfo.2: It doesn't look like Rami believes the Turtle Anima. What must be done to calm Rami's vengeance?

default.0: You didn't lose the herb sack, did you?
